name: VastPlan Database Runtime

subcommands.name: providers

subcommands.name: metrics
subcommands.description: 输出脱敏、低基数的连接池与事务标准指标

subcommands.name: activate
subcommands.description: 发布或轮换连接 revision

subcommands.name: execute

subcommands.name: begin
subcommands.description: 在当前 Runtime 实例开始短期事务

subcommands.name: commit
subcommands.description: 提交实例亲和事务

subcommands.name: rollback
subcommands.description: 回滚实例亲和事务

subcommands.name: create
subcommands.description: 创建声明式记录

subcommands.name: get

subcommands.description: 按受限过滤和游标分页列出记录

subcommands.description: 开始 Repository UnitOfWork
